question: With which of the following classical dances is ‘Kottakkal Sivaraman’ associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathakali.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kottakkal Sivaraman**__

 __
 
• **Kottakkal Sivaraman was a performing artist.**
 
• He revolutionized the portrayal of female roles in Kathakali, the classical dance-drama from Kerala in southern India.
 
 
 
• **Kathakali**__
 __
 
• The classical dance form Kathakali originates primarily from the Indian state of Kerala.
 
• **Kathakali is a blend of dance, music, and acting and dramatizes stories, which are mostly adapted from the Indian epics.**
 
• The dancer expresses himself through codified hasta mudras and facial expressions, closely following the verses that are sung.
 
• The characters in a kathakali performance are broadly divided into Satvika, Rajasika, and Tamika.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Odissi**__

 __
 
• Odissi is a dance form from the state of Odisha in eastern India.
 
• It is recognized as one of the eight classical dance forms of India.
 
 
 
• **Mohiniyattam**__
 __
 
• **Mohiniyattam is an Indian classical dance form that evolved in the state of Kerala, India.**
 
• It is counted among the two popular dance arts of the state, the other being kathakali.
 
• Mohiniyattam literally interpreted as the dance of '**Mohini', the celestial enchantress of the Hindu mythology, **
 
 
 
• **Bharatanatyam**__
 
 
• Bharatanatyam is a pre-eminent Indian classical dance form presumably the oldest classical dance heritage of India is regarded as the mother of many other Indian classical dance forms.
 
• It is initiated in the **Hindu temples of Tamil Nadu and eventually flourished in South India.**
